title: Build session-health dashboard
acceptance: Show source ages, unknown, live/replay mode and prototype limitation; no green safe state.
evidence: Local fixture dashboard: six synthetic replay scenarios, independent capture/heartbeat age, unknown/stale/disconnected display, bounded activity and persistent replay/prototype labels. No live backend/device connection or credentials.

10 Node.js model tests and 43 shared Python tests passed, including four real HTTP preview-server checks. Browser verified all six scenarios, pause/expiry, no horizontal overflow at 320/390/768/1024/1440 widths, and no console warnings/errors.

Follow-up: 12 Node model tests and all 44 shared Python tests passed, including five HTTP tests. Browser verified independent phone/Pi disconnect states and partial transport. Eight synthetic scenarios; illustrative evidence initially hidden until availability is established.

Opt-in session-scoped viewer projection and private issuance CLI: native routes/default factory unchanged; secure same-origin cookie, revocation/expiry, bounded polling, no images/distances or device/operator grants in the browser. Capture ages remain unknown; actual mode and lineage retained.

16 Node model tests and 59 shared/dashboard Python tests passed on Windows/Linux; 128 backend cases: Windows 121 passed/7 skipped, Linux 122 passed/6 skipped. Synthetic verified-TLS/native-Origin tests and browser login/unknown/disconnect checks passed. Optional container built and factory/assets/port smoke passed without network or production activation.
blocker: Public activation awaits Michael review of the opt-in viewer auth/projection interface at this PR head (decisions/CR-CS-041-dashboard-viewer-interface.md). Software is ready for review; true capture-age bounds remain unknown without a separately reviewed clock mapping. No device, inference-accuracy, motor or GPIO readiness claim.
